subject: Suncrest pilot: hosting carveout & one-off procurement ask
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@suncresthealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Suncrest pilot scope & hosting requirements

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick note to capture what we discussed and to loop in Deal Desk/Legal for the one-off hosting asks you raised.

Recap of Suncrest asks for the pilot:
- Private deployment: Redwood runtime deployed into Suncrest's Azure subscription (customer-managed VNet) with no persistence of PHI outside region.
- Data residency: all inference data must remain in US (primary region: us-east-2).
- Audit access: Suncrest requests a 90-day rolling audit window and the ability to request on-demand traces during an escalated incident (customer-run SOC team).
- Egress: no external egress of raw data; logs only by agreement.
- Commercial: pilot (3 months) with a 40% discount and waiver of onboarding fee; possibility to convert to a reserved Dedicated contract afterwards.

Attachments: Suncrest_SOW_v1.pdf, suncrest_security_questionnaire.xlsx (filled).

Jordan — can Deal Desk confirm whether we can accommodate the audit window and the requested discount? If not, what trade-offs would you need (timeboxed audit, KMS options, higher upfront payment, agent-based on-prem connector)?

Oliver — happy to coordinate a short call if we need to walk the SRE/Infra team through the technical approach.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Suncrest_SOW_v1.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Suncrest pilot scope & hosting requirements

Thanks for the summary, Jordan. A few quick clarifying questions and an initial position from Deal Desk: 

Questions: 
- When you say "no persistence of PHI outside region," do you expect Redwood to sign a data processing amendment + contractual residency clause, or is a technical guarantee (customer-controlled VNet + no-logging) sufficient?
- Is Suncrest open to a timeboxed/limited audit (e.g., two 30-day audit windows in the first 6 months) rather than a continuous 90-day rolling window?

Deal Desk initial take: 
- Standard pilot concessions: we can offer up to 20% off list for a 3-month pilot plus waived onboarding for strategic accounts with exec approval.
- Anything >25% or any clause that gives a customer continuous onsite audit rights beyond our standard audit play (redwood-managed logs review + SOC2 packaging) requires VP-level signoff and legal carveouts.

Irene — flagging this for you because of the requested residency/audit carveouts and the wide discount ask. If this is strategic (expansion runway) we can push to leadership with clear guardrails (customer-managed KMS, limited audit scope, on-prem agent option).

I'll hold on formal concession language until we get more details.

—Marissa
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: suncrest_security_questionnaire.xlsx]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Suncrest pilot — recommended exec clearance

Laura / Markus — escalating for exec clearance. Context below + my recommendation.

Why this matters: Suncrest is a 1,000+ clinician network with aggressive roadmap for LLM-enabled chart summarization. They have the potential to convert to a multi-year Dedicated contract (~$1.2M ARR) if pilot shows results. Winning a strict-residency, low-egress playbook is a strategic precedent for other healthcare accounts.

Customer asks that require deviation:
- Customer-managed VNet deployment inside Suncrest Azure subscription (we would install a Redwood runtime agent in their VNet).
- Customer requests a 90-day rolling audit window and ad-hoc trace extraction during incident response.
- Requested commercial: 40% pilot discount + waived onboarding (3-month pilot).

My recommended guardrails if leadership approves concession:
- Approve up to 30% discount for pilot only (3 months). Any deeper discount requires Finance/RevOps signoff on revenue write-down.
- Audit: offer two 30-day audit windows in first 6 months + an on-demand incident review performed jointly; deny continuous rolling 90-day unrestricted access. Require signed SOW specifying what logs/traces may be requested and the operational lead time.
- Security: customer-managed KMS + network isolation; no raw data egress; use a read-only, time-limited support token for any Redwood engineering assistance.
- Legal: require indemnity clause scoped to data handling and a liability cap tied to fees.

Attachments: audit-schedule-proposal.csv (draft audit windows).

I recommend granting an interim exec clearance to Marissa to negotiate a 30% pilot concession if legal accepts the indemnity and audit guardrails above.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director of Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audit-schedule-proposal.csv]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-18T18:07:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Escalation: Suncrest pilot — recommended exec clearance

I reviewed the proposed guardrails and have the following redlines / requirements before Legal signs off: 

Key legal conditions: 
- Audit scope must be strictly defined in the SOW: specific log types, time ranges, frequency, and escalation process. No open-ended "on-demand trace extraction."
- Customer-managed KMS required for encryption-at-rest; Redwood must not hold any keys for Suncrest data.
- Network isolation: prefer an on-prem agent that never sends raw payloads off the customer's VNet. If we use customer-managed VNet deployment, require a secured support tunnel that is initiated by customer and only for debugging (time-limited).
- Liability: cap liability to the fees paid in the prior 12 months; carveouts only for gross negligence / willful misconduct.
- Indemnity to be mutual but scoped to data handling specifics.

If the customer accepts the SOW language above, Legal will clear a 30% pilot discount for sign-off. Anything beyond 30% (or granting 90-day rolling audit access) is not acceptable without formal board-level approval.

Markus
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@suncresthealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Escalation: Suncrest pilot — recommended exec clearance

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. I approve the conditional concession as follows: 

Approved items (exec clearance):
- Up to 30% discount on pilot fees (3 months) contingent on Finance sign-off for revenue treatment.
- Two timeboxed 30-day audit windows in the first 6 months and a documented incident review process (no open-ended rolling 90-day access).
- Customer-managed KMS required; no Redwood-held keys.
- Use of on-prem agent or customer VNet deployment with a customer-initiated, time-limited support tunnel for debugging.

Conditions before signature: 
1) Legal to finalize SOW language reflecting strict audit scope and indemnity/liability caps (Markus).
2) Finance to approve accounting treatment of the concession (Marissa, please loop in RevOps).
3) Customer must accept the above and sign the updated SOW/DocuSign.

Marissa — you are cleared to negotiate to the 30% level with Suncrest under the listed guardrails. Please update the HubSpot deal record and attach the redlined SOW.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
